name: white-warren
description: Local-first CRM workspace access for Claude Desktop and other MCP clients.
long_description: White Warren exposes the local CRM database as a stdio MCP server. Clients can inspect modules, list and search records, update and restore records, add notes, link records, detect local SuiteCRM configuration, and export a complete workspace bundle.

tools.name: ironcrm_workspace_summary
tools.description: Summarize the local White Warren workspace, including modules and record counts.

tools.name: ironcrm_list_modules
tools.description: List CRM modules and field definitions.

tools.name: ironcrm_search_records
tools.description: Search records and note activity across CRM modules.

tools.name: ironcrm_get_record
tools.description: Get one record with relationships and activity timeline.

tools.name: ironcrm_create_record
tools.description: Create a local White Warren record.

tools.name: ironcrm_update_record
tools.description: Update fields on a local White Warren record.

tools.name: ironcrm_restore_record
tools.description: Restore a soft-deleted White Warren record.

tools.name: ironcrm_add_note
tools.description: Add an activity note to a record.

tools.name: ironcrm_link_records
tools.description: Create a relationship between two records.

tools.name: ironcrm_detect_suitecrm
tools.description: Detect a local SuiteCRM config.php and return a read-only connection summary.

tools.name: ironcrm_export_workspace
tools.description: Export a complete White Warren workspace bundle as JSON.

local_db_path.title: White Warren database
local_db_path.description: Optional path to a White Warren SQLite database. Leave blank to use the default desktop workspace.
